text:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME demoed a 'response-audit' feature (signed trace of prompts + outputs). Sales says a few enterprise prospects will push hard for this. Should we accelerate 'provenance tracing' (audit trail) vs the perf/quant work scheduled for Q2? My gut: it's a differentiation wedge for regulated customers but risk to perf roadmap. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Leah: Sales: two large pilots asking for signed output records + retention controls. They said competitor demoed it this week and it's making them consider shortlisting. Timeline ask: pilot in 6-8 weeks.

Kevin: Do we have estimate for engineering lift? Are we talking metadata headers + S3 archive, or deeper model-level provenance (token-level hashes)?

Sophie: Design/product idea: ship 'audit-mode' v1 with per-call metadata envelope + immutable signed hash of (prompt, model-id, model-checksum, output). Minimal UX: enable toggle per-tenant, downloadable audit bundle. Low UI surface area.

Raj: Engineering: token-level hashes and KV-caches will be trickier. But we can start with session-level signed bundles. Rough guess: 2wk spike + 4-6w engineering to reach a secure v1 if we reuse existing logging infra. Storage/costs need decisions (hot vs cold).

Sam: Platform: per-tenant toggle + retention_policy is doable. We can write bundles to cold storage (archive) to keep cost down, serve on-demand. Need KMS signing integration (HSM/KMS) for legal compliance.

Kevin: Perf tradeoff? Signing + extra I/O will add latency. Do we accept a small p50 bump for audited calls? Also impacts batching and KV cache because we must capture exact model-checksum at call time.

Leah: Customers expect negligible latency impact. They care more about traceability and legal provenance than a 50–100ms hit. Sales can negotiate pilot expectations if we have a timeline.

Maya: Proposal: 2-phase plan
1) Spike (2w): spec, threat model, KMS prototype, storage cost estimate.
2) V1 (canary per-tenant, 6w): session-level signed bundles, per-tenant retention, admin UI + API to download bundles.
If spike OK, deprioritize one perf subtask (quantization polish) for Q2. Volunteers for spike?

Sophie: I can own the admin UI spec and sample bundle format. I'll sketch a minimal page + download flow.

Raj: I'll take the spike infra work (KMS + write path).

Kevin: I'll scope perf regression window and list affected benchmarks.

Leah: I'll align pilot expectations with ACME and two other prospects. Will push for pilot commitments.

Maya: Great. Action items:
- Sophie: UI spec + sample bundle (3d)
- Raj: KMS prototype + cost calc (1w)
- Kevin: perf impact doc + benchmarks (1w)
- Leah: pilot agreement terms (4d)
We'll reconvene EOW. If spike shows low friction we fast-track.

deploy-bot: spike-ticket created: RD-1428 'provenance-audit-spike' — owners: Sophie, Raj, Kevin, Leah — due: 1 week.

Sam: One ask — include option to redact PII in bundles by default and document retention TTLs. Legal will need that.

Maya: Good call. Add 'PII redaction' to spike checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
